description: Files a feature request for AI Buildout Permits on Brick & Mortar's public request board (brickandmortar.dev/requests), where anyone can read and upvote it, and notifies the person who builds AI Buildout Permits. For something AI Buildout Permits does not do or hold yet: a state or record source it does not hold, a company it has not resolved, a field it does not return. title is the person's own words, verbatim and short; detail is optional; contact is an email or handle exactly as they offered it, sent to the builder only and never shown on the board. ok true means it was filed.

contact.description: Optional: email or handle for a reply, verbatim, only if offered

detail.description: Optional: what they were trying to do

title.description: What they want, in their own words, ideally under 90 characters

name: request_a_feature
title: Request a AI Buildout Permits feature
